Freeze unchanged knowledge/i01/v1 manifest and all complete-card identities; resolve or explicitly suspend needs_source_review points before scoring.
Obtain same-version Timken original PDF/hash/visual verification, or explicitly accept remaining documentary gap and its impact on score eligibility.
Automated source/migration-restriction review, with educational-only limits and source gaps preserved; no human or expert sign-off required.
Freeze caller-specified predicted_class/task_types as module-test inputs common to all four groups; use module semantics in all prompts.
If real upstream is later requested, obtain separate authorization and bind one shared classifier/task result per input before any four-group divergence.
Separately authorize and define later end-to-end assessment including classification errors.
New dated provider/endpoint/alias approval, declared generation/verification/revision identities and immutable-version limitations.
Bind request alias, returned alias, request IDs and known route metadata; do not claim an independently confirmed hidden backend version.
Independently approve candidate tokenizer, recipe, full chat template, native/runtime profile and exact source hashes for E02.
Count full system/user payload, JSON wrapper/schema and evidence; reject unsupported literal special tokens and unapproved profiles.
Record provider usage separately; preserve unknown values rather than equating local count with service billing.
Approve and freeze exact generation, verification, revision and manual-provenance prompts and executable schema hashes.
I01 prompt asserting actual image/model origins cannot be reused for manually assigned E01 inputs.
Freeze the same common generation template/parameters and basic citation check across four groups.
Approve per-action models, thinking mode, response format, temperature, input/output limits, sampling/seed behavior and known nondeterminism.
Any model/profile change invalidates candidate counter/price and requires new review.
Freeze text/text+verify/graph/graph+verify paired comparison with identical request/upstream provenance/common knowledge/common generation/basic citation check.
Only retrieval mode and additional content verification vary; preserve original ordering, global top_k=3 unique complete cards and at most one revision using the same cards.
Record actual card count, full payload characters, UTF-8 bytes, full-chat input tokens/output usage; equal card counts do not imply equal text budgets.

Implement/verify fail-closed complete-payload limit before sending: if any full card bundle plus prompts/schema/wrappers exceeds approved input/context/reserve, save overlength status and stop that cell; no trimming, refilling, hidden truncation or automatic retry.
Preflight each verification and single-revision payload too; output truncation remains explicit failure.
Approve length-stop denominator handling before run.
Approve exact E02 per-stage/per-cell/whole-batch attempt ceilings, timeouts, retries, concurrency, redirects and environment-proxy policy.
Preserve failure/TLS/rate-limit/malformed/truncated responses and all attempted-cost reservations; unknown cost stays unknown; no replay on restart or late success.
Confirm at most generate+verify+one revise+verify for verify groups; one generate for unverified groups subject to independent release.
Approve number of repeats, exact question and group ordering/randomization seed and schedule before observing outputs.
Use paired cells and preserve every outcome; no best-of selection, output-dependent order, selective retry or replacement.
Treat repeats as nested within question and knowledge corpus; never as independent devices.
Fresh dated official pricing snapshot/URL/hash for selected model and cache-miss input/output rates, currency, discounts and billing assumptions.
User-approved new E02 hard currency ceiling plus worst-case full-cap reserve calculation for all authorized attempts; reject batch if budget is insufficient.
Freeze new durable batch ledger/nonrefund rules, concurrency control and actual/estimated/unknown cost reporting.
Do not inherit or reset any prior I01/Q01 budget or ledger.
Freeze original E01 metric definitions and synthetic oracle, separate expected failure/missing/service failure from reasonable evidence insufficiency and knowledge-score zeros.
Report zero denominator as undefined/NA with counts; do not turn missing into success or exclude failures after looking.
Record verification-added errors separately from fixed/retained errors; publish per-cell counts and paired descriptive summaries.
Document weak reserve coverage: two narrow intents across OR/RE only; no independent four-scenario heldout claim.
Recheck current code/data/source/link/cache/historical anchors, all prior gates and exact new run identity.
Receive direct authorization after reviewable configuration/budget/automatic-judge/source restrictions exist.
Write a new explicit release record for a separately scoped E02 run; this preparation checklist never flips release by itself.
Bind automatic policy, metric/half-credit definitions, judge model identities/limitations, prompts, schema and parameters before observing new outputs.
Two new-context agents independently score 100% cells with group/verification/cost signals hidden; retain both outputs and quote/reason validation.
Keep automatic mapping outside business prompts and evaluator scoring input; record blinding limitations and same-model correlation.
Third-agent review of disagreements and preregistered high risks; preserve original scores and machine adjudication with version/quotes/reasons.
Distinguish evaluator failures, source uncertainty and evaluated-system failures; retain unresolved denominators and ranges.
No human scoring, arbitration or signature; do not infer expert truth from agreement.
